waypoints.name: Huron Peak Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US 24 between Buena Vista and Leadville, turn west on Chaffee County Road 390 at Clear Creek Reservoir and drive about 12 miles of dirt road to the old townsite of Winfield. Continue south about 2 miles on the rough 4WD road, staying right at the junction after 0.7 mile, to the trailhead at the road end. Passenger cars park near Winfield and walk the road.

waypoints.name: Huron Peak
waypoints.directions: Follow the Huron Peak trail into the forest, cross a stream after about half a mile, switchback up the slope, then head south to treeline near 11,900 ft. Cross the high basin to the east and switchback up Huron's northern slopes to the north ridge near 13,500 ft; the rockier ground between about 13,700 and 13,900 ft is the crux before the final slopes to the summit.
